prerequisites: Mathematics I (836): Numbers and functions, Numerical methods
Chemistry (838): Atomic theory and atom composition, Chemical bond, Chemical kinetics, Oxidation-reduction reactions, Polymers in the plastic industry

learning_outcomes.text: Know the different types of materials, their properties and applications in Engineering.
Select the most suitable material for the different applications that may arise in the exercise of their profession, accurately comparing and weighing the properties of competing materials.
Redesign products by replacing some materials with others to maximize the potential of each.

syllabus_topics: Ferrous materials: Classification according to various criteria
Influence of alloying elements on the iron-carbon diagram
Stainless steels: martensitic, ferritic and superferritic, austenitic
Relationship between aggregation state and mechanical, thermal, chemical, optical and electrical properties
Polymer processing: Machining and joining processes in polymers
Design, calculation and manufacturing of plastic parts and products
Ceramic materials: Introduction and classification of ceramic materials
Refractory ceramic materials, abrasives, cements, glasses, glass-ceramics, advanced ceramics, composite ceramic materials and ceramic biomaterials
Attacks and failures due to corrosion
Visit to CTCR and/or local manufacturing company
assessment_rules: Students must obtain at least 35% of the maximum score on written tests to pass the course. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the total course grade will be FAIL, with the resulting score from the sum of grades obtained in all evaluation systems, truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points. Observation techniques will be evaluated in theory classes, problem-solving sessions, and laboratories. Attendance and observation in laboratories will be evaluated with a maximum of 5% non-recoverable. For students with recognized part-time study dedication, non-recoverable activities may be replaced by similar ones with a different completion period or by equivalent evaluation tests, provided the reason for non-completion is the same as the one for which part-time status was granted.
